items.title: Communication troubleshooting
items.summary: Timeouts, disconnects or inconsistent protocol behaviour with no clear cause. We reproduce the failure and isolate where it starts.
items.heading: Timeouts, disconnects,
items.intro: For device vendors, integrators and engineering teams whose industrial communication fails now and then, and nobody can say why. We make the failure happen on demand, find where it starts, and tell you what to change.
symptoms: Requests time out a few times a day, never while someone is watching
Connections drop after hours or days of normal operation
A device works with one master, gateway or firmware version and fails with another
The device vendor, the integrator and the IT team each suspect someone else
items.impact: A fault you cannot reproduce cannot be fixed with confidence. Each occurrence means another log hunt and another escalation, and the next release may ship with the same fault.
approach: In the free assessment we discuss the symptoms and constraints and decide together whether we are the right fit.
Before we examine code, logs or traffic, we agree a paid technical investigation: scope, deliverables, time limit and price, approved by you.
We reproduce the failure with a test harness or device emulator, so it happens on demand instead of at random.
We narrow the fault across software, configuration and the interface until the cause is isolated.
We agree the corrective actions and how the fix will be validated.

example.text: A Modbus TCP device times out several times a day after a new SCADA master is installed. A test harness replays the master's polling pattern against the device and varies timing and load until the timeout appears on demand. With the failure reproducible, the fault is traced to one side of the link, and the same harness becomes the regression test for the fix.

deliverables: A reproducible test that triggers the failure
Written findings: the cause, the evidence and the affected components
An agreed validation, which can stay in your test suite
